candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The target quantity ks/Ra is the normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness. ks has units of length and Ra is a characteristic height (length), so their ratio is dimensionless. Buckingham analysis with the provided inputs yields a dimensionless dependent variable formed from length-like inputs normalized by Ra; all statistical and slope/porosity parameters are dimensionless and therefore do not contribute dimensional exponents.

variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment (mean absolute deviation) of surface height fluctuations; a characteristic roughness height scale.
Peak-to-valley height: the vertical distance between the maximum peak and minimum valley on the surface profile.
Root-mean-square height of surface fluctuations: quadratic measure of roughness amplitude.
Dimensionless skewness: third central moment of height fluctuations normalized by the cube of their RMS height, measuring asymmetry of the height distribution.
Dimensionless kurtosis of the height fluctuations: fourth standardized moment measuring distribution peakedness and tail weight.
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness, a geometric slope ratio characterizing incline in the streamwise direction.
Surface porosity: fraction of surface area occupied by pores or open area; dimensionless.

variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment (mean absolute deviation) of surface height fluctuations; a characteristic roughness height scale.
Peak-to-valley height: the vertical distance between the maximum peak and minimum valley on the surface profile.
Root-mean-square height of surface fluctuations: quadratic measure of roughness amplitude.
Dimensionless skewness: third central moment of height fluctuations normalized by the cube of their RMS height, measuring asymmetry of the height distribution.
Dimensionless kurtosis of the height fluctuations: fourth standardized moment measuring distribution peakedness and tail weight.

Surface porosity: fraction of surface area occupied by pores or open area; dimensionless.

ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The target quantity ks/Ra is the normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness. ks has units of length and Ra is a characteristic height (length), so their ratio is dimensionless. Buckingham analysis with the provided inputs yields a dimensionless dependent variable formed from length-like inputs normalized by Ra; all statistical and slope/porosity parameters are dimensionless and therefore do not contribute dimensional exponents.

variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment (mean absolute deviation) of surface height fluctuations; a characteristic roughness height scale.
Peak-to-valley height: the vertical distance between the maximum peak and minimum valley on the surface profile.
Root-mean-square height of surface fluctuations: quadratic measure of roughness amplitude.
Dimensionless skewness: third central moment of height fluctuations normalized by the cube of their RMS height, measuring asymmetry of the height distribution.
Dimensionless kurtosis of the height fluctuations: fourth standardized moment measuring distribution peakedness and tail weight.
